description: f32 [3, 4]: a stepped slice, then a full reduction.
reference: torch.sum(x, dim, keepdim) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: x is fed as a stepped slice view (every second row along dim 0, from row 1). out is computed in f64 from the inputs and rounded once to the dtype under test; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator). f16/bf16 accumulate in f32 (graph-ir.md §3.1.8). Without dim every dim is reduced; a result PyTorch returns as 0-dim is [1] here (graph-ir.md §3.1.5).
